howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.tooltip: Three simple steps to start receiving outreach distributions with Cosmic Signature

promote.title: Promote
promote.description: Share Cosmic Signature across social media, blogs, and communities.
promote.tooltip: Create content, share referral links, write blog posts, or produce videos about Cosmic Signature to qualify.

verify.description: Our team reviews and verifies your promotional activity.

receive.tooltip: Once verified, CST tokens are sent on-chain to your wallet address. Allocations scale with the impact of your outreach.
